title: 017 同病相怜018 只有陆泽受伤的世界
slug: 从小欢喜开启诸天之旅
content_zh:
刘静跟季胜利两个人正在客厅看着电视。
老季这个区长还是比较喜欢没事的时候看一看新闻，关注一下国内外大事，政治思想觉悟很高。
刘静则是很享受这种家庭温馨的感觉，尤其是当那两个孩子在家的时候。
她能够清楚的感受到季杨杨跟自己关系的逐渐递进，看着陆泽跟杨杨拌嘴，她总会不自觉的笑。
“我们回来啦！”
“小姨，你们在看电视呢？”
陆泽在家里一直都很活跃。
一方面是为了帮助表弟打破跟父母之间那层薄薄的隔阂，更大的原因还是他已经把这里当成了自己真正的家。
杨杨、小姨还有小姨夫都是他的亲人。
亲人之间，随意才是最正常的相处状态。
客客气气的绝对不是最亲的人。
“你们两個在外面吃饭了没有？”刘静从沙发上起身就要往厨房走，声音温和：“我给你们两个人留了饭菜，要是饿的话，我再去热一热。”
陆泽连忙摆了摆手：“不用啦，我们在外面吃了不少的零食，还喝了瓶饮料。”
季杨杨在旁边跟着点了点头。
这个家伙在送完黄芷陶之后并没有选择自己回家，而是等到了陆泽，非要跟他一起回去。
实际上，季杨杨就是想搞清楚表哥这葫芦里到底卖的什么药。
不会真喜欢上人家乔英子了吧？
在他看来。
还是觉得黄芷陶要更好看一点儿。
刘静跟他们两个人正唠着嗑，我们的季胜利区长有点不合时宜的问了个问题：“那个小泽，你之前打电话说杨杨约女孩子看电影，这个女孩子也是你们同学吗？”

陆泽立刻咳嗽不止。
季杨杨眼睛瞪得贼大，满脸不可置信的望向表哥。
我靠。
你追人家英子也就算了。
竟然还是拿我当的挡箭牌？
杨杨很受伤！
“对啦，伱们两个人的补习班我给你们看好啦。”
“等我找时间去报了名就能开始上课，就在咱们家楼上，宋倩阿姨那里。”
......
乔英子回到家里的时候，妈妈宋倩正在辅导着几个学生，英子如同往常一样跟妈妈打了声招呼。
“妈，我在外面吃过啦，我先进去写作业了，后天我们还得分班考。”
看着女儿这般样子，宋倩有些自责于早上誓师大会时候的那种举动。
她嘱咐学生们先自习，跟着来到了英子的房间。
“英子，妈妈要跟你说声对不起，今天我...”
乔英子把书包里的课本练习册转移到书桌，神情无奈的冲着妈妈说道：“妈，那件事论不上谁对谁错，主要我的梦想是成为宇航员，七百分并不是我的梦想啊。”
不知道为什么。
宋倩隐约的感觉今天英子的身上似乎发生了某种变化，这是身为母亲的第六感。
“你放学发消息说跟桃子出去玩，你们两个女生去哪里了？”
“不止桃子，还有我们班的两个男生，就上次来咱家的那两个，陆泽跟季杨杨。”乔英子拿起试卷开始埋头做了起来，头也不回的说道：“我们去看电影了。”
宋倩这才想到了一件事情。

“哦哦，那两个男孩子我有印象，那个季区长好像就是他们的家长吧。”
“今天跟他爱人来找我，说是想要给那两个孩子报个班，最好还可以在书香雅苑这边补习。”
低着头阅读试卷的乔英子眼睛瞬间一亮。
哼。
content_en:
Liu Jing and Ji Shengli were watching TV in the living room.
The district chief, Lao Ji, still prefers to read the news and pay attention to major domestic and international events when he has nothing to do. He has a high level of political and ideological awareness.
Liu Jing enjoys the warm feeling of family, especially when the two children are at home.
She could clearly feel the gradual progress of Ji Yangyang's relationship with her, and she would always laugh unconsciously when she saw Lu Ze bickering with Yang Yang.
"We're back!"
"Auntie, are you watching TV?"
Lu Ze has always been active at home.
On the one hand, it is to help his cousin break down the thin barrier between him and his parents. The bigger reason is that he has regarded this place as his real home.
Yang Yang, his aunt and uncle are all his relatives.
Between relatives, casualness is the most normal state of getting along.
The person who is polite is definitely not the person closest to you.
"Have you two eaten out?" Liu Jing got up from the sofa and walked to the kitchen. Her voice was gentle: "I left some food for you two. If you are hungry, I will heat it up."
Lu Ze quickly waved his hand: "No need, we ate a lot of snacks outside and drank a bottle of drink."
Ji Yangyang nodded next to him.
This guy did not choose to go home by himself after seeing off Huang Zhitao. Instead, he waited until Lu Ze arrived and insisted on going back with him.
In fact, Ji Yangyang just wanted to find out what kind of medicine his cousin was selling in this gourd.
You don’t really like Qiao Yingzi, do you?
In his opinion.
I still think Huang Zhitao is better looking.
While Liu Jing and the two of them were chatting, our district chief Ji Shengli asked a question a little inappropriately: "Oze, you called before and said that Yang Yang asked a girl to watch a movie. Is this girl also your classmate?"
Lu Ze immediately started coughing.
Ji Yangyang's eyes were wide open and he looked at his cousin in disbelief.
Holy shit.
Just forget it if you chase Yingzi.
Are you still using me as a shield?
Yang Yang is very hurt!
"That's right, I'll take care of the cram school for you two."
"The class will start when I find time to sign up. It will be at Aunt Song Qian's place upstairs at our house."
...
When Qiao Yingzi returned home, her mother Song Qian was tutoring several students. Yingzi said hello to her mother as usual.
"Mom, I've eaten out. I'm going to do my homework first. We have to take the class test the day after tomorrow."
Seeing her daughter like this, Song Qian blamed herself for her behavior during the swearing-in ceremony in the morning.
She asked the students to study by themselves first, and followed them to Yingzi's room.
"Yingzi, mother wants to say sorry to you. Today I..."
Qiao Yingzi moved the textbook and exercise book in her schoolbag to the desk, and said helplessly to her mother: "Mom, it's not about who is right or wrong about that matter. The main thing is that my dream is to become an astronaut. Seven hundred percent is not my dream."
Don't know why.
Song Qian had a vague feeling that something had changed in Yingzi today. This was her sixth sense as a mother.
"You sent a message after school saying you were going out with Taozi. Where were you two girls?"
"Not only Taozi, but also two boys from our class, the two who came to our house last time, Lu Ze and Ji Yangyang." Qiao Yingzi picked up the test paper and started working on it, and said without looking back: "We are going to watch a movie."
Only then did Song Qian think of something.
"Oh, I have an impression of those two boys. District Chief Ji seems to be their parent."
"His wife and I came to me today and said we wanted to enroll those two children in a class. It would be best if they could take tutoring here at Shuxiang Yayuan."
Qiao Yingzi's eyes lit up instantly as she lowered her head to read the test paper.
snort.
